gen-gf-pixelify-sans-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans reads with wide-open bowls and a technical but friendly manner, like a plain sans that wants you to follow along. And Pixelify Sans above it brings bold, blocky letters of constant line weight, which is where the pair gets its spark.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-zilla-slab: Sturdy and a bit technical, Zilla Slab gives the page its footing, with broad openings on its rounded letters. Pixelify Sans above it adds a bold, unvarying line that plays against the slab-serif.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-amulya: Revalia's widely spaced letters stride along with a tall, relaxed confidence. It does the loud work up top, while Amulya, a modern sans-serif with generous curve gaps and a lower lowercase, handles the quieter reading below.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-chillax: Revalia comes in bold, with an open-tailed g and a tall lowercase. Chillax answers with a casual, loose, pen-lifted line that sits lower and keeps the sans-serif side of the pair relaxed and unhurried.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-plein: Revalia stretches out with a tall lowercase and widely separated letters, giving the headline a bold, expressive presence. Plein follows in a reliable, clean voice, with clear channels into each round letter that keep a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between its curve ends and stems. Revalia takes the bold display role above it, and its tall, widely spaced letters stand well apart from the moderate lowercase of that sans.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-synonym: Revalia opens with a tall band of widely spaced lowercase and a relaxed, expressive stride. Synonym settles into a plain stripe of constant ink with generous curve openings, so a long passage would feel clean and dependable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-aclonica: A lowercase g with an open lower curve marks Revalia out at once. It handles bold, expressive display work, while Aclonica, a neutral sans-serif with a deep midsection and gentle stroke contrast, carries the steadier reading job.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-allerta: Revalia's tall band of lowercase, with short stalks above and a relaxed stride between widely separated letters, grabs attention immediately. Allerta's loose tracking and prominent x-height make the strongest difference.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-alumni-sans: Approachable and clean, Alumni Sans keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height and its contrast soft. Revalia does the bold, expressive shouting with tall, widely spaced letters, while Alumni Sans, a plain sans, does the gentle, open reading.
